text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Agnes Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I think I'll drop by the lab.
I want to check on the state of the new drug, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It should be finished by tomorrow,
so we'll likely be able to move on to the experiment in the morning."
Agnes Tachyon continues her research and experiments almost every single day...
choice_data_list: Have you ever gotten tired of your research?
Have you ever gotten tired of your research?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?
Things are evolving every single day, you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The same goes for my research.
Muscles, internal organs, bones—even their structures—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"What was right today might
be disproven tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why the path of body sculpting is so arduous
and fascinating.
choice_data_list: No time to get bored, huh?
You won't have a moment to get bored, huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's how it is. Now that you understand,
I'll see you tomorrow. Good night, Trainer-kun.
—And so, the next day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Good morning, Trainer!
Here, start off by drinking this!"

Along with a morning greeting,
I was forced to swallow a pill that gave off an indescribably foul stench...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Tastes so bad you want to spit it out, right?!
Yet that suffering will transform into something truly invaluable!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You'll understand the effects once you try it!
Come on, I'll run alongside you, so get moving!

I ran for about an hour just as Agnes Tachyon instructed, but—
...There's no particular change in my body.

More importantly, the taste of that pill is still lingering
in my mouth... Ugh, it's simply awful.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see... Pulse is normal, no different
from standard running. No changes in muscle tone either.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Her complexion seems a bit poor, but...
let's assume for now that it's for another reason.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I understand, Trainer-kun!
In short, this experiment is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —It's a failure!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, over the final 200 meters,
your time was slightly faster than usual.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Though it's already a very subtle difference.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
By the way, it was supposed to make you feel
light as a feather. But well, it's not half—

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Doing dangerous experiments and trying to get faster with drugs...
I thought those were just rumors."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho? You look like a Tracen Academy student too,
would you happen to be interested?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to correct one thing, though.
My medicine is strictly meant to—

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Please! Share that medicine with me!
I want to get faster...!

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I keep losing all the time...
So I don't care if it's cheating anymore!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, wait a moment.
Calling it cheating is unfair; this is, you see...

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting, so please!

Having said her piece, the curly-haired Umamusume
dashed away...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, if she truly wants the medicine,
shouldn't she be cooperating with me as well?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Stealing all the glory like that... I can't say I approve.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, the next time I spot them,
I'll be sure to have them thoroughly participate in my experiment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, I'm looking forward to it...

Agnes Tachyon chuckled merrily
as she watched the Umamusume run off...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, she'll realize soon enough.
That there are no parlor tricks in my experiments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, my interest was piqued.
Her eyes were burning with fighting spirit."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, to try relying on medication...
Maybe I should look into this a bit.
Agnes Tachyon chuckled low in her throat, gazing amusedly at the back of the Umamusume running off into the distance.
